scope: Fresh isolated single-node NeoExpress chain: deployment of the contracts/bin/platform core, every contracts/bin/v3 public module and the sibling NeoDIDRegistry build, a hand-signed AA proxy-witness transaction that consumes a NeoDID action ticket, protocol flows driven by real transactions, and JSON-RPC readback of every deployed contract. No public network, no production deployment, no signing or broadcast outside the private chain.
